newsitem.title: USA: Equity Residential sees FFO above analysts' view.
newsitem.headline: Equity Residential sees FFO above analysts' view.

text.p: Equity Residential Properties Trust said Thursday it expects its 1997 funds from operations to be in the range of $3.55 to $3.60 a share, above analysts expectations.
The current mean analysts' estimate calls for funds from operations of $3.46 a share, according to the real estate investment trust and First Call.

"Based upon the 1996 results at the property level, follow through of the 1996 acquisition program, the pending Wellsford Residential Property Trust merger as well as estimated earnings results from our 1997 acquisition program, we believe the company can achieve ffo for 1997 in the range of $3.55 to $3.60 per share," chief executive officer Douglas Crocker said in a news release.
In January, Equity Residential announced an agreement to acquire New York-based Wellsford in a deal valuing Wellsford at about $1 billion.
Earlier Thursday, Equity Residential reported funds from operations of $0.85 a share for the fourth quarter, compared to $0.70 a share a year ago.
Equity Residential shares were up 1-1/2 at 44-3/8 Thursday.
